title: Leaving Omaha: the ten-piece band with nine leaders
summary: Jones describes a band in Omaha that changed leaders and uniforms at each gangster-run job, mentioning Elmer Crumley and Mary Osborne.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Now when you came - you worked in Omaha but you heard about all these great things happening down in Kansas City. Now when did you come down to Kansas City and who did you join down there?
Unfortunately for me I had to leave Omaha, Nebraska. Elmer Crumley was playing with the band that I
was playing with, 10-piece band, there were 9 leaders and I had all the business. They changed leaders like we used to change at the Embers..... only changed uniforms.
Elmer Crumley - he's a great trombone player.

Right... He left us to join the Blanche Calloway but he left us to go, as I told you, to play Villa King (Denise,) right? O.K. Now Thaddeus who was in Chicago and our trumpet player, was playing in the band. Bill Owens had the band at the Cloverleaf Club in Omaha, Nebraska, but we had 9 leaders and each time they changed leadership whoever had the band - if a guy came in and said, "Milt, I want you to play in my club. Can you get a band together?" "Sure." So what you did was come in the band room and say, "Well, fellows, we going over here for 3 months," and we all changed uniforms. Here's your band but it's the same people, the same book. We worked like that for 3 years.
Now what band was it? You were in this band?
It was a band of about 10 people that had 9 different leaders.
Whoever got the job was the leader.
Whoever the gangster thought that it should be the leader, he said, "fellows, we got a place to go." And you just went and changed your uniform. We made it!
Omaha, Nebraska, round in that territory, see. Naturally he had Tom Archer that had the Acorda Ballroom, that had the Rigodon Ballrom in That's how I met you had this... Mary Osborne.
Oh, Mary Osborne, a great guitar lady, a great guitarist, yes, and a teacher.
Her sister was a dancer. All right. So now you see these are things -
